information: This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) Get ready for a day of big cubes and blindfolded solving in San Jose! # This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube. If you'd like to compete in 3x3, see [Bay Area Side Events Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayAreaSideEventsDay2025). All attendees are required to be quiet during blindfolded events, as these events require lots of concentration. If you would like to talk during a blindfolded event, please step outside of the venue first. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. If you're interested in unofficial events, check out [Bay Area Side Events Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayAreaSideEventsDay2025), a competition in San Jose on the same weekend!
